facts.text: UMass Global MyPath programs are fully online, competency-based degrees where grading is mastery-based instead of using letter grades or GPA.

sources.title: Self-Paced Programs | UMass Global
sources.quote: UMass Global MyPath is a competency-based learning experience where you progress by demonstrating mastery of defined competencies instead of earning credit for attendance, participation, or weekly assignments.
